build_eagle2_5_vl_model: build an Eagle2.5-VL multimodal model for conditional generation with SigLIP vision encoder and Qwen2 language model
create_multimodal_processor: create an Eagle2.5-VL multi-modal processor with InternVL image processor and configurable dynamic patch settings
run_extract_feature: run visual feature extraction from pixel values using SigLIP vision model with pixel shuffle downsampling
test_pixel_shuffle: test the pixel shuffle downsampling operation on vision feature tensors with configurable scale factor
summarize_forward_pass: summarize the forward pass through the Eagle2.5-VL model for conditional generation with multimodal inputs
